title: Arcane Oracle Chamber
description: A hooded figure in a blue robe kneels in a dark stone chamber, holding a glowing blue orb that emits liquid light. Large floating blue stone tablets covered in golden glowing runes and symbols surround the figure, with more runes and handprints visible on the curved walls and floor.
